finding.summary: Retry regimes stack: the SDK's own max_retries (429/5xx/timeouts) run inside model.invoke, and with_retry adds up to ATTEMPTS=3 app-level attempts on top. Worst case for a persistently malformed reply is 3 app attempts × 3 SDK attempts = 9 HTTP calls, each with backoff up to 8s (app) plus SDK backoff — potentially minutes of wall-clock latency per chat() call, multiplied across a 30-file review loop.
finding.fix: Set the chat model's max_retries to 0 (or 1) so HTTP-level retries are owned by exactly one layer, or reduce ATTEMPTS, and document/verify the combined worst-case latency budget.
